# OEIS stage 3 results

All fifteen reference candidates reproduced every listed term. Five targets have 773 new terms in total, each reproduced by two independent algorithms in clean subprocesses and compared exactly with the delivered b-file. No commit or upstream submission was made.

Host: macOS-27.0-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O. Python: 3.13.4 (v3.13.4:8a526ec7cbe, Jun  3 2025, 21:14:54) [Clang 16.0.0 (clang-1600.0.26.6)].

## Re-run

From `research-sprint/oeis`:

```sh
make -C stage3 verify
```

The command rebuilds the C++ reference enumerator if needed, reproduces every listed term for the fifteen candidates, recomputes every claimed extension with both methods, compares each b-file byte for byte, and audits the stored evidence. It runs offline and uses one computing process at a time. Each method has a timeout below the inherited single-command limit. `make -C stage3 extend` is the explicit online refresh-and-regenerate workflow; it is not needed to verify the supplied results.

## Sources and selection

See [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) for current keyword, revision, b-file, full-history, and external-table evidence. The shortlist reuses eligible reserves and adds new composition predicates from fresh `keyword:more` searches. No candidate with a still-valid earlier rejection was reused. A112907 reproduced successfully but was dropped as an extension target after its next term was found indirectly in the published A112908 quotient table.

## Definitions and methods

### A374680

"Number of integer compositions of n whose leaders of anti-runs are strictly decreasing." [A374680](https://oeis.org/A374680).

Previous range 0..25. New range 26..256. Complete file: [b374680.txt](results/b374680.txt).

Reference method: Positive integer state DP by consumed weight, previous part, and last anti-run leader, requiring the next leader to be smaller.

Independent method: Formal power series of whole maximal anti-runs, joined at equal boundary neighbors; solve in increasing leader order.

Measured verification CPU seconds: reference 1.824112, independent 1.009975. Peak process RSS bytes: reference 251822080, independent 18612224.

Exact sequence-only re-run:

```sh
python3 stage3/code/verify.py --id A374680
```

### A374681

"Number of integer compositions of n whose leaders of anti-runs are weakly increasing." [A374681](https://oeis.org/A374681).

Previous range 0..25. New range 26..256. Complete file: [b374681.txt](results/b374681.txt).

Reference method: Positive integer state DP by consumed weight, previous part, and last anti-run leader, requiring the next leader to be at least the previous leader.

Independent method: Whole anti-run generating functions, solved in decreasing leader order, with an algebraically eliminated equal-leader self transition.

Measured verification CPU seconds: reference 1.706836, independent 1.311328. Peak process RSS bytes: reference 230539264, independent 18546688.

Exact sequence-only re-run:

```sh
python3 stage3/code/verify.py --id A374681
```

### A374682

"Number of integer compositions of n whose leaders of anti-runs are weakly decreasing." [A374682](https://oeis.org/A374682).

Previous range 0..25. New range 26..256. Complete file: [b374682.txt](results/b374682.txt).

Reference method: Positive integer state DP by consumed weight, previous part, and last anti-run leader, requiring the next leader to be at most the previous leader.

Independent method: Whole anti-run generating functions, solved in increasing leader order, with an algebraically eliminated equal-leader self transition.

Measured verification CPU seconds: reference 1.958308, independent 2.100852. Peak process RSS bytes: reference 246988800, independent 18825216.

Exact sequence-only re-run:

```sh
python3 stage3/code/verify.py --id A374682
```

### A383710

OEIS describes partitions of n for which "it is not possible to choose a family of pairwise disjoint strict integer partitions, one of each part." [A383710](https://oeis.org/A383710).

Previous range 0..20. New range 21..65. Complete file: [b383710.txt](results/b383710.txt).

Reference method: Enumerate each outer integer partition. Search for disjoint strict refinements of its parts using bitmasks; count failures.

Independent method: Enumerate a globally strict partition of the total, then every unlabeled set partition of its summands. Deduplicate block-sum partitions and subtract feasible totals from Euler pentagonal partition counts.

Measured verification CPU seconds: reference 65.377900, independent 60.704031. Peak process RSS bytes: reference 185942016, independent 45776896.

Exact sequence-only re-run:

```sh
python3 stage3/code/verify.py --id A383710
```

### A383711

Count partitions of n "with no ones" for which "it is not possible to choose a family of pairwise disjoint strict integer partitions, one of each part." [A383711](https://oeis.org/A383711).

Previous range 0..30. New range 31..65. Complete file: [b383711.txt](results/b383711.txt).

Reference method: Enumerate outer integer partitions without ones. Search for disjoint strict refinements with bitmasks; count failures.

Independent method: Enumerate globally strict summands and unlabeled blocks. Deduplicate block-sum partitions without ones; subtract from p(n)-p(n-1), with p obtained by Euler pentagonal recurrence.

Measured verification CPU seconds: reference 10.786267, independent 68.339121. Peak process RSS bytes: reference 142147584, independent 21872640.

Exact sequence-only re-run:

```sh
python3 stage3/code/verify.py --id A383711
```

## Why the algorithms are independent

For anti-runs, the DP appends individual parts. An unequal neighbor stays in the current anti-run; an equal neighbor starts the next anti-run and triggers the leader comparison. Aggregating counts by leader reduces the transition cost without changing this state model. The independent program uses no DP states and instead counts entire anti-runs as formal power series.

Put q_j = z^j/(1+z^j) and D = 1-sum_j q_j. The generating function for a nonempty anti-run starting with L is q_L/D. The generating function for such an anti-run ending with j is delta(L,j) q_L + q_L q_j/D. Decomposing a composition at every equal adjacent pair gives a unique sequence of maximal anti-runs. If H_L = 1 + sum over strictly allowed j of q_j F_j, strict descent gives F_L = q_L H_L/D. For either weak order, solve the equal-leader transition to obtain F_L = q_L H_L/[D(1-q_L)-q_L^2]. All inverses have constant coefficient one, so integer power-series arithmetic suffices. The implementation truncates exactly at the requested degree.

For the partition targets, one method fixes the outer partition and tries strict refinements of each part with disjoint bitmasks. The independent method reverses the construction: all refinement summands together form one globally strict partition, and grouping them into unlabeled blocks yields exactly the feasible outer partitions. A set removes multiplicity from different valid families. Euler pentagonal recurrence supplies the total partition count independently. Neither method reads the other program, expected terms, earlier-stage extension values, or the delivered b-file.

The full per-index timing curves are in `data/references.json`. Anti-run references use exhaustive composition enumeration, which shows exponential growth. The selected DP and series algorithms avoid that enumeration. Partition references are small at the published ranges; extensions use bounded memoization in the outer-partition search to keep memory finite. These are chosen, verified computational frontiers, not claims that larger terms are impossible or that the CPU allowance was exhausted.
